title: All 15 scenarios passed
summary: The CI run executed 15 scenarios across builtin, cap, and flow families. All 15 passed on the first boot cycle. The tested commit is a merge of PR #139 (hands-free audio) into dev. The change set adds wake-word detection, hands-free voice interaction, reverse audio bridge transport, and related capability contracts. No failures were observed in the primary run.
pr_changes: Added wake-word detection service (robonix/service/speech/wake_word) with sherpa-onnx KWS backend
Added hands-free controller in Liaison (system/liaison/src/handsfree.rs) with wake-word loop, voice turn orchestration, and event streaming
Added reverse audio bridge transport (audio_client_bridge) where the robot listens for client connections instead of dialing out
Added capability contracts for hands-free set_enabled, status, and events
Added bridge_info contract for reverse audio endpoint discovery
Modified audio_driver to use exclusive mic stream lock and preserve deployment-selected devices
Modified speech service to support pluggable backends (local/tencent/mock) and wake-word model download
Modified Pilot to cancel executor plans on abort_turn
Modified voice session to support barge-in metadata and no-speech timeout
Updated stop.sh to kill voiceprint_service and updated audio driver pkill patterns
test_result: Webots CI exercised 15 scenarios: 4 builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, plan_control_builtins, run_command), 8 cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), and 3 flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). All passed with 100% rate. The explore tasks timed out as expected (5s/8s ceilings). Navigation succeeded. A restart run showed a flaky object_navigation failure due to navigation aborts, but the primary run was clean.
suggested_fix: Monitor the flaky object_navigation scenario; the restart run showed navigation aborts possibly due to velocity guard or rotation guard trips. Consider increasing timeout or adjusting navigation parameters.
risks_or_watchouts: The restart run showed a flaky object_navigation failure (navigation aborted) — may need investigation
Scene graph LLM enrichment failed repeatedly (JSONDecodeError from fake-vlm) — expected with mock VLM but could mask real issues
New hands-free and wake-word capabilities are not yet covered by CI scenarios
Reverse audio bridge transport is not exercised in CI (no client connection)
